questions.question: When King David told Saul's grandson Mephibosheth to divide the land with Ziba, how did Mephibosheth answer?

answers.text: Give me back all of it
Let the king keep it all

questions.question: When King David invited the old man Barzillai to live with him in Jerusalem, why did Barzillai ask to go home?

answers.text: To die in his own city near his parents' tomb
To look after his flocks out in Gilead
To get his fields ready for the harvest

questions.question: When King David said goodbye to the old man Barzillai at the Jordan, what did David do?
As King David came back across the Jordan, what did the men of Israel complain about?

answers.text: Judah took the king across secretly
The king took too long to come back
The king left them out of his army
